# Ranking Fixer

> Ranking Fixer (rankingfixer.com) is a technical SEO consultancy run by Calebe Araujo, a full-stack developer and tech lead based in Sorocaba, Brazil, working remotely with businesses and agencies in the United States and other English-speaking countries. It finds the technical problems that keep websites from ranking on Google and implements the fixes in the code, the theme or the CMS. Contact: calebe.development@gmail.com.

Verifiable results cited on the site: page load cut from 8 s to 1 s after migrating legacy systems to Angular and Svelte; a microservices CRM integrating 25 sites; 60+ landing pages and business websites shipped with technical SEO; 100/100 Lighthouse scores on calebearaujo.com.br. Ranking Fixer does not guarantee rankings, buy links or sell content packages.

## Services

- [Technical SEO audit](https://rankingfixer.com/technical-seo-audit): crawling, indexing, rendering, speed and structured data, ranked by impact, with fixes implemented.
- [Core Web Vitals optimization](https://rankingfixer.com/core-web-vitals-fix): LCP, INP and CLS fixed at the source.
- [Google indexing fixes](https://rankingfixer.com/google-indexing-issues): Search Console page indexing errors.
- [SEO website migration](https://rankingfixer.com/seo-website-migration): redesigns, replatforming, domain changes and traffic drop recovery.
